wfcore.machine.radar.name: Radar
wfcore.machine.radar.tooltip: Finds enemy bases by clustering nearby machines and players. Needs sky access and Y >= 100. Requires EV power and computation from a Mainframe (via a Computation Reception Hatch).
wfcore.machine.printer.tooltip: Prints a written report of bases found in radar scan data.
wfcore.machine.vehicle_factory.tooltip: Assembles a vehicle and deploys it in front of the factory. Recipes are programmable (KubeJS); the recipe's output item is the vehicle.
wfcore.machine.large_transformer.tooltip: Converts DC EU to/from AC EU, cooled by coolant. Needs one AC Input and one AC Output hatch, plus DC energy hatches and a coolant input.
wfcore.machine.mainframe.tooltip: Provides computation (CWU/t) to research units and radars. CPUs supply compute, RAM caps throughput, coolers fight heat. Output it through a Computation Transmission Hatch.
wfcore.machine.research_unit.tooltip: Runs research using materials, power and computation. Completed research is written to a data stick.
